name: The Final Flush
summary: A side mission started from a "Stop! Don't Flush" poster that ends with a permanent boost to stamina.
body: Scan a "Stop! Don't Flush" poster with the WAiNK scanner (the normal camera does not work) and answer TRUTH to the text that follows.
Meet Dr. Merle at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta and give him the code 00-00-02, then follow him to the sewage plant in Hamlet and through a hidden room.
The reward is a permanent increase to maximum stamina.

The guides disagree on when it opens (Output Lag says Chapter 3, TechWiser from Chapter 1) and on where the posters are: Output Lag names a toilet stall in the Nine1Nine club and a gym toilet, TechWiser the public beach restroom on Corsair Key.

facts.location: Frank's Waffles, Tequesta; sewage plant, Hamlet
